input: Negotiate my monthly internet and cable bill

gold.taskTitle: Negotiate Lower Monthly Internet and Cable Bill
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to negotiate their current internet and cable bill to reduce their monthly costs.

questions.title: Who is your current internet and cable provider?
questions.description: Identify the specific provider the user is negotiating with.

questions.title: What is your total monthly bill right now?
questions.description: Establish the current baseline cost before negotiation.

questions.title: How long have you been a customer with this provider?
questions.description: Determine customer tenure, which is a key leverage point in negotiations.

questions.title: What specific outcome do you want from this negotiation?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a lower rate, a promotional deal, service upgrades, or cancellation.

questions.title: Are you open to canceling or switching providers if needed?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is willing to use cancellation as a negotiation tactic.

questions.title: Have you tried negotiating with this provider before?
questions.description: Find out if there is any prior negotiation history that could affect strategy.

questions.title: Do you know what competitor plans are available in your area?
questions.description: Determine if the user has researched competing offers to use as leverage.
